name: Ironveil Interactive
welcome: Welcome to the official Ironveil Interactive app. Follow our projects, read development updates, and join the community.
about: Ironveil Interactive is an independent game development studio creating immersive experiences across games and Minecraft add-ons. Currently focused on high-quality Minecraft add-ons, with plans to expand into original games in the future.
vision: We build worlds worth getting lost in. Whether it runs inside Minecraft or stands on its own, every Ironveil project is held to the same bar: thoughtful design, real polish, and respect for the players who spend their time with it.
currentFocus: Right now our focus is high-quality Minecraft add-ons. The Unnamed and Tactical Villagers are where our development effort goes today, and they are how we sharpen the craft we will carry into our original titles.
futureGoals: Ship our first original game as an independent studio
Keep releasing add-ons that raise the bar for what Minecraft content can be
Grow the Ironveil Creator Program into a genuine partnership with creators
Build a download system so you can get our add-ons straight from this app
Launch the official Ironveil website and project hub
